candidates.change_summary: Remove the if(intitalized)revert(); guard so MinSum can be changed even after initialization.
Change the require from 'if(intitalized)revert()' to 'if(!intitalized)revert()' so MinSum can only be set when already initialized.
Replace 'MinSum = _val' with 'MinSum = _val + 1' to always set a different value.
Replace 'MinSum = _val' with 'MinSum = 0' to ignore input and always set to zero.
Insert 'MinSum = MinSum + 1;' after the assignment to change its final value by incrementing.
Replace 'if(intitalized)revert();' with 'require(msg.sender == address(0));' to restrict setting MinSum to zero-address only.
Delete the if(intitalized)revert(); check so MinSum can be set multiple times.
Replace the if(intitalized)revert(); check with a condition that always reverts, blocking any update.
Replace the assignment MinSum = _val; with MinSum = _val + 1; so the stored value differs.
Delete the initialization check 'if(intitalized)revert();' so the Log variable can be overwritten after initialization.
Replace the unlock time update condition so that unlockTime is unconditionally set to block.timestamp + _lockTime, ignoring the existing acc.unlockTime.
Delete the require statement checking for overflow of block.timestamp + _lockTime.
Replace the first require with require(false) so that Put always reverts.
Replace the second require with require(false) so that Put reverts after balance update but before unlock time update.
Replace the condition in the unlock time update with `if (true)` so that unlockTime is always overwritten.
